Looping in some technical detail to set expectations for Fri's load run. Key proposal:

Planned test phases (Fri 23):
1) Ramp (20m): linear ramp to target throughput; monitor OOMs/KV miss ratio
2) Steady-state (30m): sustained target throughput to capture p95/p99
3) Spike test (10m): short bursts at 150% target to verify graceful degradation

Initial parameters (please confirm):
- Model variant: redwood-7b-quant (compatible with your quality bar)
- Target sustained throughput: 15k tokens/sec total
- Hardware footprint for run: 8 × A100 equivalent (dedicated test cluster)
- Sequence length distribution: 80% <= 128, 15% 128–512, 5% 512–1024
- Latency targets: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 160ms, p99 < 350ms (token-level generation)
- KV cache: warming enabled, prefix cache expected for common prompts
- Metrics to collect: per-token latency, GPU util, batch sizes, KV hit ratio, requests/sec, token/sec

Attachments: loadtest-config.yaml (contains the launcher parameters, ramp schedule, and metric hooks). I’ll push the config to the shared drive after we lock time.

If BrightFin prefers a lower starting throughput (e.g., 12k tokens/sec) we can scale back; the important bit is agreeing a single baseline so we can iterate.

— Karthik
Staff ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
